entities.summary: Jeonju Abu Bakr Al‑Seddiq Mosque, often called as Jeonju Mosque, located in Deokjin-gu, Jeonju, Jeolla, South Korea and serves as an important center for Islamic worship and cultural exchange for both foreign residents and Korean converts.
